About_&_Key_Points:
About
Jindal Poly Films Limited is a part of the B.C. Jindal group. It is the largest manufacturer of BOPET and BOPP films in India. The company produces BOPET, BOPP, CPP, Thermal, Metalized and Coated Films.

Business Segments FY24
1) Packaging Films (79%):
[1]
The co. was the largest manufacturer of BOPET and BOPP films in India. It produced BOPET, BOPP, CPP, Thermal, Metalized, Coated and Capacitor Films. In Aug 2022, it executed a business transfer transaction where the packaging films business undertaking was sold to its subsidiary JPFL Films on a slump sale basis for Rs. ~2,400 Cr.
[2]
2) Non-Woven Fabrics (~14%):
It produces PP-based ‘Spunmelt’ and ‘Spunbond’ Nonwoven Fabric.
3) Labels Division (7%):
Through its subsidiary, SMI Coated Products, the co. offers  200+ different products of self-adhesive labels.
